text.font-family: 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Georgia, serif

svg.text: # Les Miserables: who appears in a scene with whom (Knuth, 1993)
# A matrix shows each pair twice: row a, column b and row b, column a
# The only change: sort by group (who belongs together), not by name
The picture this code drew, run as it is printed
Order the characters by group, then name. Nothing else
The clusters appear as blocks on the diagonal.
